sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Juggler Memory Match is a tile-swapping game where you slide tiles to reassemble a picture. The game features a 3x3 grid, with each tile containing a piece of the larger image. Your goal is to move the tiles around to their correct positions, creating a complete and cohesive picture. The game starts with a blank slate, and as you progress through the levels, the puzzles become increasingly difficult.

One of the key mechanics in Juggler Memory Match is the use of empty spaces. When a tile is moved to an empty space, it creates a new opening, allowing you to access hidden tiles and reveal new parts of the picture. This mechanic adds a layer of strategy to the game, as you need to carefully plan your moves to maximize your chances of solving the puzzle.

The game also features a timer, which adds an element of pressure to the gameplay. As you progress through the levels, the timer gets shorter, and you'll need to think quickly and make the most of your moves to solve the puzzle before time runs out. But don't worry, you can always take your time and play at your own pace if you need to.
